paper_title: Results of a Search for Paraphotons with Intense X-ray Beams at SPring-8
coupling_convention: photon-paraphoton kinetic mixing angle chi, dimensionless, as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 4
notes: LSW (light-shining-through-wall) paraphoton search at SPring-8 X-ray beamline BL19LXU. The paper explicitly quotes a mass-independent combined limit chi < 8.06e-5 (95% C.L.) valid for 0.04 eV < m_gamma' < 26 keV, encoded here as a two-point horizontal bound. The actual limit curve (Fig. 4) has structure (spikes at low mass, worst value 8.01e-5 at 1.39 eV before systematics), but the paper's stated final result is the flat conservative bound.
